title: FBI Photo A007
what_is_it: A single still image submitted to AARO as a reported unidentified anomalous phenomenon (UAP) sighting.
interpretation_warnings: No source PDF text was extractable; all facts derive from war.gov metadata and the narrative description only.
No date or location was provided, so the event cannot be independently placed or corroborated.
The image was redacted before submission, so context and original data markings are obscured.
The narrative description is explicitly informational and reflects no analytical judgement or conclusion about the object's nature.
Single-source submission with an observer who could not identify the object; a specular highlight and reticle framing are consistent with many mundane sensor artefacts.
